notes: The parts list gives 3 hook-up wires, but the circuit image shows 5 jumper wires (3 long to the Arduino, 2 short on the breadboard); all 5 are modelled.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue: the image's upper half (rows f-j) is bank 'b'. Rail holes (tp/tn numbers) are approximated from the image; the top red rail is tp (+) and the top black rail is tn (-).
Resistor is 10k ohm per the manual, with value=10000 (catalogue default label is 100 ohm).
Photoresistor and resistor are in different rows of the same column strips: LDR in row g, resistor in row h; both share column 10 (the A0 midpoint).
The Arduino GND wire is assumed to go to GND.2, the lower of the two GND pins on the power header, as in the image.
